title: A Portrait for the Ledger
author: Sable Quintana
blurb: Zephyrine Okonkwo, a true-crime podcaster chasing the coldest case on record, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. But when a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do before the anniversary dinner raises its glass.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
